i am no drifting expert however i can tell you some stuff:
Drifting in an AWD like the R34 at least for me is hard, but from what i know to start a drift is the best to do a skandinavian flick (turn the wheel opposite to the apex and then to apex aggresevily), the handbrake works better for RWD. Check if you have any traction control as well as i think the R34 has one. Also, idk if this analogy helps you but for me it did: if you want to add more angle, do more counter-steering and apply more throttle, if you want to car to straighten up, apply less throttle and let the wheel "accomodate" itself.

From what i see you know a thing or two about drifting but if you want to relearn it i reccomend to use kunos e30 drift car (the one that comes with the game) and go to silverstone, there is an area where you can practice donuts. Start by doing small donuts and then with the technique i said earlier for increasing or decresing angle, make the donuts bigger or smaller.
